title: 第25章 有老婆有闺女人生无憾也第26章 你是个好人
slug: 都市修仙五年下山就无敌
content_zh:
买一个货架的内衣是不可能的。
叶凡拦住柳盈盈的霸总行为，与她精挑细选了十几件，付账离开。
回家路上。
柳盈盈正色道：“叶凡，你现在没有工作，花钱不能大手大脚。”
这些内衣单件不贵，加在一起花了上万元，叶凡抢着付了钱。
“这是我送你的礼物。”
“谢谢。”
“我想看你穿那件粉色蕾丝的。”
“……滚！”
柳盈盈俏脸发黑，原来叶凡在这里等着。
思虑片刻，柳盈盈递来一张信用卡：“这张卡额度十万，你先拿着用，每个月我会还款。”
叶凡神色古怪。
自己这算被包养了吗？
“老婆，你对我真好。”
“……我才懒得管你，我只是怕女儿有需要花钱的地方，你让她失望！”
柳盈盈扭头看向窗外。
过了片刻，语气随意道：“你最好找个工作，整天在家里无所事事的像什么样子。别看依依懒散，她偶尔给公司设计服装图案，还接漫画插画图，每个月赚不少。”
“行，听老婆你的。”
叶凡心底美滋滋的，被管说明柳盈盈心里有他，不然谁会管陌生人找不找工作。
找个什么工作好呢。

风水卜卦医术丹药，符箓阵法飞剑御物，这些叶凡都很擅长。
他忽然问道：“老婆，你还缺秘书吗？”
“……不缺。”
柳盈盈面无表情道：“另外，公司不允许办公室恋情。”
“可惜。”
叶凡先是遗憾，然后纳闷道：“不对，咱俩也没谈恋爱啊。”
“……”
柳盈盈突然不想搭理叶凡了，闭目养神。
晚上六点钟。
天际残留一轮晚霞。
柳依依刚到家不久，叶凡二人也回来了。
柳依依接过姐姐手里的手提袋，随意瞥了一眼，柳眉微微挑起。
哎呦。
是内衣。
她又好奇的瞥向其他袋子，当看到全是性感内衣时，顿时倒吸一口凉气。
叶凡这臭流氓。
一整个白天带姐姐都做了什么？
察觉妹妹表情变化，柳盈盈解释道：“买回来的样品，准备带回公司研究。”
content_en:
It is impossible to buy a rack of underwear.
Ye Fan stopped Liu Yingying's domineering behavior, carefully selected a dozen items with her, paid the bill and left.
On the way home.
Liu Yingying said seriously: "Ye Fan, you don't have a job now, so you can't spend money lavishly."
Each piece of these underwear was not expensive, and together they cost tens of thousands of yuan. Ye Fan rushed to pay for them.
"This is my gift to you."
"Thank you."
"I want to see you in that pink lace one."
"...get out!"
Liu Yingying's pretty face turned dark, it turned out that Mark was waiting here.
After thinking for a moment, Liu Yingying handed over a credit card: "This card has a limit of 100,000. You can use it first. I will repay it every month."
Ye Fan looked strange.
Does this count as being taken care of?
"Wife, you are so kind to me."
"...I don't care about you. I'm just worried that my daughter will need to spend money and you will let her down!"
Liu Yingying turned to look out the window.
After a moment, he said in a casual tone: "You'd better find a job. What do you think of sitting at home doing nothing all day long? Don't look at Yiyi's laziness. She occasionally designs clothing patterns for the company and also takes on comic illustrations. She makes a lot of money every month."
"Okay, wifey, listen to you."
Ye Fan felt happy in his heart. Being controlled meant that Liu Yingying cared about him. Otherwise, who would care whether a stranger could find a job or not.
What kind of job should I find?
Ye Fan was very good at Feng Shui, divination, medical elixirs, talisman formations, flying swords, and objects.
He suddenly asked: "Honey, do you still need a secretary?"
"...There is no shortage."
Liu Yingying said expressionlessly: "In addition, the company does not allow office romance."
"What a pity."
Ye Fan felt regretful at first, and then wondered: "No, we are not in love either."
"..."
Liu Yingying suddenly didn't want to talk to Ye Fan anymore and closed her eyes to rest.
Six o'clock in the evening.
There is still a sunset glow in the sky.
Not long after Liu Yiyi arrived home, Ye Fan and Ye Fan also came back.
Liu Yiyi took the handbag from her sister, glanced at it casually, and raised her eyebrows slightly.
Ouch.
It's underwear.
She curiously glanced at the other bags, and when she saw they were all sexy lingerie, she gasped.
Ye Fan is such a stinky gangster.
What did you do with your sister all day long?
Noticing the change in her sister's expression, Liu Yingying explained: "The samples I bought are going to be taken back to the company for research."
